description: The line plot illustrates the loss evolution over iterations for various models, including a vanilla baseline and several variants of SepLLM with different configurations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," spans from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes six distinct lines: a purple line for "Vanilla," a blue line for "StrmLLM (n=64)," an orange line for "SepLLM (n=64)," a green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)," a red line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," and a dark blue line for "SepLLM (n=128)." All models start with a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0, which rapidly decreases for all models. The "Vanilla" model shows the highest loss across most of the iteration range, while the "SepLLM (n=128)" model exhibits the lowest loss, stabilizing around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" and "SepLLM (n=64, H)" models follow a similar trend, with the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model showing slightly lower loss than "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and "StrmLLM (n=64)." The "SepLLM (n=64)" model shows a slightly higher loss than the other SepLLM variants.
